== History == BLS International was founded in 2005 by Diwakar Aggarwal, whose family had earlier run a polymer compound manufacturing business.{{Cite web |last=Rao |first=Rukmini |date=2026-04-19 |title=The Emerging 100: BLS International’s local playbook, global outlook |url=https://www.fortuneindia.com/long-reads/the-emerging-100-bls-internationals-local-playbook-global-outlook/131929 |access-date=2026-08-02 |website=Fortune India |language=en}} He moved into services after governments began outsourcing the administrative side of visa processing to private contractors.{{Cite web |last=Singh|first=Surbhi Gloria|date=20 November 2025|title=Faster visas, fewer queues: BLS Int'l on how Indians are reshaping demand|url=https://www.business-standard.com/immigration/faster-visas-fewer-queues-bls-int-l-on-how-indians-are-reshaping-demand-125111900742_1.html|website=Business Standard}}{{Cite web |last=Sethi|first=Vaamanaa|date=2025-02-16|title=Multibagger stock: Nuvama suggests THIS visa service providing share to buy with 60% upside {{!}} Stock Market News|url=https://www.livemint.com/market/stock-market-news/multibagger-stock-nuvama-suggests-bls-international-services-stock-to-buy-raises-target-price-11739700049340.html|access-date=2026-05-12|website=mint|language=en}}{{Cite web |last=Rao|first=Rukmini|date=2026-04-19|title=The Emerging 100: BLS International’s local playbook, global outlook|url=https://www.fortuneindia.com/long-reads/the-emerging-100-bls-internationals-local-playbook-global-outlook/131929|access-date=2026-05-12|website=Fortune India|language=en}} The company's first embassy engagement was with the Portuguese embassy in New Delhi, followed by work for other European missions. In 2008 it secured its first large contract from the Indian government, operating for the Indian embassy in Kuwait.{{Cite web |title=Management Meet Note BLS International Services Ltd|url=https://www.nuvamawealth.com/ewwebimages/WebFiles/Research/a90ef3e8-a759-49cc-921e-5e3e4880bcff.pdf|website=Nuvama Wealth}}{{Cite web |last=Das|first=Vipul|date=2023-03-27|title=BLS International inks agreement with the Embassy of Poland in Manila for VISA outsourcing services|url=https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/bls-international-inks-agreement-with-the-embassy-of-poland-in-manila-for-visa-outsourcing-services-11679922260749.html|access-date=2026-05-12|website=mint|language=en}}{{Cite web |title=BLS to operate India visa application centres in China under new 3-year contract|url=https://www.khaleejtimes.com/world/asia/bls-india-visa-services-china-centres|access-date=2026-05-12|website=Khaleej Times|language=en}} Between 2005 and 2015 the company opened visa application centres in the United Arab Emirates and Southeast Asia and took on several Indian diplomatic missions, including posts in the United States and Canada, the Consulate General of India in Hong Kong and the High Commission of India in Kuala Lumpur. It won a global visa contract for Spain, which broadened its work for European governments.{{Cite web |title=Airport transit visas|url=https://www.exteriores.gob.es/Consulados/sanfrancisco/en/ServiciosConsulares/Paginas/Consular/Visado-de-transito-aeroportuario.aspx|archive-url=http://web.archive.org/web/20250515061853/https://www.exteriores.gob.es/Consulados/sanfrancisco/en/ServiciosConsulares/Paginas/Consular/Visado-de-transito-aeroportuario.aspx|archive-date=2025-05-15|access-date=2026-08-01|website=www.exteriores.gob.es|language=en-US}} Shikhar Aggarwal, son of the founder, joined the business in 2014 and became joint managing director. The company was listed on the National Stock Exchange and the Bombay Stock Exchange in 2016.{{Cite web |title=India: Delhi court lifts 2-year debarment on BLS International|url=https://www.khaleejtimes.com/world/asia/delhi-court-lifts-2-year-debarment-bls-international|access-date=2026-05-12|website=Khaleej Times|language=en}} In the same year it entered domestic digital and government-to-citizen (G2C) services in India.{{Cite web |date=2017-08-24 |title=Enterprising BLS International Services |url=https://www.outlookbusiness.com/invest/enterprising-bls-international-services-2184 |access-date=2026-08-02 |website=Outlook Business |language=en}} In 2018 it began providing support to [[Sopra Steria]] and UK Visas and Immigration for visa renewals in the United Kingdom. == Business and operations == BLS International operates in two segments. Visa and consular services account for about 80% of revenue and include visa processing, passport and attestation work, biometric enrolment, e-visa issuance and related value-added services for embassies and consulates. In April 2026 the company signed a memorandum of understanding with the India and [[General Union of Chambers of Commerce, Industry and Agriculture for Arab Countries|Arab Countries Chamber of Commerce, Industry and Agriculture]] to expand commercial attestation services in India.'''{{Cite news |last=Chaudhury |first=Dipanjan Roy |date=2026-08-01 |title=India-Arab business chambers join hands to push trade & investment ties |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/economy/foreign-trade/india-arab-business-chambers-join-hands-to-push-trade-investment-ties/articleshow/132790390.cms?UTM_Source=Google_Newsstand&UTM_Campaign=RSS_Feed&UTM_Medium=Referral&from=mdr |access-date=2026-08-01 |work=The Economic Times |issn=0013-0389}}{{Cite web |title=Indian business leaders form new partnership to strengthen India-Arab economic ties |url=https://www.arabnews.com/node/2652918/amp |access-date=2026-08-01 |website=Arab News |language=en}}''' Digital services, run through the subsidiary BLS E-Services, account for the remainder and serve the Indian market. === Digital services === The digital services segment provides business correspondent services for banks such as the [[State Bank of India]] and [[Punjab National Bank]] in areas without bank branches. It also provides e-governance services, including issuing birth and death certificates and processing PAN and property registrations, and assisted e-commerce through retail outlets. BLS E-Services completed an initial public offering that raised about {{INRConvert|301|c}}. In August 2025 the [[Unique Identification Authority of India]] awarded BLS International a six-year contract valued at about {{INRConvert|2055|c}} to establish and operate district-level [[Aadhaar]] Seva Kendras.'''{{Cite web |title=Visa processing firm BLS’ arm acquires Aadifidelis Solutions |url=https://www.vccircle.com/visaprocessing-firm-bls-arm-acquires-aadifidelis-solutions |access-date=2026-05-12 |website=VCCircle |language=en-US}}{{Cite web |title=Analyst Report |url=https://www.hdfcsec.com/hsl.research.pdf/HSLPCGBLSInternationalLtd-July201720170731085131.pdf}}{{Cite web |title=BLS to operate India visa application centres in China under new 3-year contract|url=https://www.khaleejtimes.com/world/asia/bls-india-visa-services-china-centres|access-date=2026-05-12|website=Khaleej Times|language=en}}''' In July 2026 the [[Government of West Bengal]], in association with the [[National Health Authority]], selected the company as one of the card-approver agencies for the [[Ayushman Bharat Yojana|Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana]] and the Ayushman Vay Vandana scheme.'''{{Cite web |date=2026-07-07 |title=BLS International bags West Bengal contract for Ayushman Bharat card approval services - CNBC TV18 |url=https://www.cnbctv18.com/business/finance/bls-international-west-bengal-contract-ayushman-bharat-card-approval-19939783.htm |access-date=2026-08-01 |website=CNBCTV18 |language=en}}''' === Acquisitions === In 2022 BLS E-Services acquired a majority stake in Zero Mass Private Limited, a business correspondent partner within the State Bank of India network.{{Cite web |last=Menon|first=Asha|date=4 July 2024|title=MC Exclusive{{!}} BLS International: Social media and SMS campaign promotes stock; price rises nearly 4% in 3 days|url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/markets/mc-exclusive-bls-international-social-media-and-sms-campaign-promotes-stock-price-rises-nearly-4-in-3-days-12731328.html|website=Money Control}} In 2024 BLS International acquired iDATA, a Turkey-based visa processor operating in about 15 countries,{{Cite web |title=BLS International Services Ltd|url=https://www.nuvamawealth.com/ewwebimages/WebFiles/Research/59d5cece-4bbc-4e1b-8317-c4c19f6f504b.pdf}} and Citizenship Invest, a Dubai firm working on citizenship-by-investment programmes for more than 20 governments.{{Cite news |date=2024-10-04|title=BLS International completes acquisition of Dubai-based Citizenship Invest|url=https://www.thehindu.com/business/bls-international-completes-acquisition-of-dubai-based-citizenship-invest/article68718100.ece|access-date=2026-05-12|work=The Hindu|language=en-IN|issn=0971-751X}} The same year it took a 57 percent stake in Aadifidelis Solutions, a loan processing company, at a valuation of about {{INRConvert|190|c}}. == Recognition == BLS International was included in Forbes Asia's "Best Under a Billion" list in 2018 and has appeared in Fortune India's Next 500 and the Business Today BT500 ranking of Indian companies by market capitalisation.{{Cite web |title=Best Under A Billion |url=https://www.forbes.com/lists/asia200/ |website=Forbes}}{{Cite web |title=Four Indian companies in Forbes Asia's 200 'Best under a Billion' 2018 list |url=https://www.forbesindia.com/article/web-special/four-indian-companies-in-forbes-asias-200-best-under-a-billion-2018-list/50841/1 |access-date=2026-05-12 |website=www.forbesindia.com |language=en}}{{Cite web |title=BT500 2025: Top 500 Indian Companies Ranking, Billionaires List, Report Card, Comparison |url=https://www.businesstoday.in/bt500 |access-date=2026-05-12 |website=Business Today |language=en}} == Regulatory and legal issues == === 2024 sexual harassment case === In May 2024, a former employee alleged that BLS International Services' chief human resources officer had sexually harassed her, following which Delhi Police registered a First Information Report (FIR). BLS denied the allegations, describing them as baseless and retaliatory. In April 2025, the investigating agency filed a closure report, which was accepted by a Delhi court after the complainant stated she had no objection.{{cite news |date=15 May 2024 |title=BLS International ex-employee alleges sexual harassment by CHRO; FIR lodged |url=https://hr.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/workplace-4-0/bls-international-ex-employee-alleges-sexual-harassment-by-chro-fir-lodged/110163911 |work=The Economic Times HRWorld}} === 2025 MEA tender dispute === On 9 October 2025 the Indian [[Ministry of External Affairs (India)|Ministry of External Affairs]] (MEA) issued an order debarring BLS International from bidding for future tenders of the ministry and Indian missions abroad for two years, citing pending court cases and complaints from applicants.{{Cite web |last=Saseendran |first=Sajila |date=2025-10-14 |title=India debars BLS International from tenders: Will passport, visa services in UAE be affected? |url=https://gulfnews.com/uae/india-debars-bls-international-from-tenders-will-passport-visa-services-in-uae-be-affected-1.500307005 |access-date=2026-08-02 |website=Gulf News: Latest UAE news, Dubai news, Business, travel news, Dubai Gold rate, prayer time, cinema |language=en}}{{Cite web |title=BLS International debarred from MEA tenders for two years; existing contracts unaffected |url=https://www.zeebiz.com/companies/news-bls-international-debarred-from-mea-tenders-for-two-years-existing-contracts-unaffected-380714 |access-date=2026-08-02 |website=Zee Business |language=en}} The company disclosed the order to the stock exchanges on 11 October and said its existing contracts were not affected, adding that Indian missions accounted for about 12 percent of consolidated revenue and 8 percent of [[EBITDA]] in the first quarter of the 2026 financial year. Its shares fell about 12 percent on the day the ban was reported.{{Cite web |title=BLS International Barred from MEA Tenders for 2 Years; Share Price Drops Over 12% |url=https://www.angelone.in/news/market-updates/bls-international-barred-from-mea-tenders-for-2-years-share-price-drops-over-12 |access-date=2026-08-02 |website=www.angelone.in |language=en}} BLS International challenged the order through a writ petition, and in December 2025 the [[Delhi High Court]] set aside the debarment, restoring the company's eligibility to bid for MEA tenders.{{cite news |date=11 October 2025 |title=BLS International debarred by MEA from future tenders for two years; Co clarifies existing ops unaffected |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/nri/latest-updates/bls-international-debarred-by-mea-from-future-tenders-for-two-years/articleshow/124478622.cms |work=The Economic Times}}{{cite news |date=19 December 2025 |title=BLS International shares rally 7% after Delhi High Court overturns MEA tender ban |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/bls-international-shares-rally-7-after-delhi-high-court-overturns-mea-tender-ban/articleshow/126071888.cms |work=The Economic Times}}{{Cite web |title=India: Delhi court lifts 2-year debarment on BLS International |url=https://www.khaleejtimes.com/world/asia/delhi-court-lifts-2-year-debarment-bls-international |access-date=2026-08-02 |website=Khaleej Times |language=en}} Separately, on 16 October 2025 the company was awarded a three-year MEA contract to establish and operate Indian Visa Application Centres in Beijing, Shanghai and Guangzhou, effective 14 October 2025.{{Cite web |title=BLS International bags 3-yr contract from MEA to set up Indian visa application centres in China |url=https://www.theweek.in/wire-updates/business/2025/10/16/dcm49-biz-bls-china-visa-centre.html |access-date=2026-08-02 |website=The Week |language=en}} === Consumer commission ruling === In November 2025, the Navsari Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission found BLS International jointly liable with a courier company after a customer's passport was returned in a damaged condition. The commission imposed a ₹10,000 penalty on BLS for appointing the courier, while directing the logistics provider to compensate the complainant for the resulting financial losses.{{cite news |date=16 November 2025 |title=Passport damaged, courier & visa partner fined |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/surat/passport-damaged-courier-visa-partner-fined/articleshow/125257143.cms |work=The Times of India}} == References == {{reflist}} == External links == * {{URL|https://www.blsinternational.com|Official website}} [[Category:Indian companies established in 2005]] [[Category:Companies based in Delhi]] [[Category:Service companies of India]]
extract:
BLS International Services Limited is an Indian company heaquartered in New Delhi. It processes visa, passport and consular applications for governments and diplomatic missions, and provides domestic e-governance and financial-inclusion services through its subsidiary BLS E-Services. The company operates visa application centres and handles application processing and biometric enrolment; decisions on individual applications are made by the client governments. It is listed on the National Stock Exchange and the Bombay Stock Exchange
BLS International began operations in 2005. As of 2026 it operated in more than 100 countries.
